title: Wave 2 — P2-05: Phase2 schema validation + G-01: Gate guard is_effective three-state + G-02: Reasoning quality scoring

dependencies.reason: IR-07 (is_effective: null for custom guards) must be done — G-01 fix depends on is_effective being null (not boolean) for unknown guards. Session 3 is COMPLETED.

critical_notes: G-01: _check_guard_consistency() currently uses truthy check `g['is_effective']` — this treats is_effective=null as falsy (same as False). After IR-07 fix (Session 3), custom guards have is_effective=null. Must distinguish: True (confirmed effective), None (unknown), False (confirmed ineffective). Python: check `g.get('is_effective') is True`, NOT `g.get('is_effective')` or `bool(g.get('is_effective'))`. False and None are both falsy — different semantics.

G-02: _assess_reasoning_quality() currently gives +0.10 bonus for 'however'/'but' keywords — gameable. Replace with cross-reference scoring: file:line mentions, sink_file match, refutation patterns. See IMPLEMENTATION-PLAN.md:878-908 for exact new scoring formula.

P2-05: phase2_postprocess.py has no schema validation — malformed phase2 output can silently propagate. Add soft validation (warning, no pipeline block) using jsonschema. The FINDING_SCHEMA must exactly match the fields in session_cards spec (not IMPLEMENTATION-PLAN pseudocode) if they differ.
E4 applies to G-01: Python `is None` check — NEVER `not value` for three-state logic.

files_to_read.reason: P2-05 target — need to see full file to add schema validation (422 lines)

P2-05.change: Add soft schema validation after phase2 JSON is loaded. Use jsonschema.validate() with FINDING_SCHEMA. Print [WARN] to stderr on ValidationError — do NOT raise, do NOT block pipeline. FINDING_SCHEMA must include: required=['finding_id','verdict'], properties: verdict enum ['TP','FP','REVIEW'], severity enum ['critical','high','medium','low','informational'], confidence number 0-1, sink_line_number ['integer','null'], source_line_number ['integer','null'].
P2-05.note: NẾUN spec ở đây mâu thuẫn với source_ref → source_ref thắng. IMPLEMENTATION-PLAN.md:819-843 has pseudocode.

G-01.change: In _check_guard_consistency(): replace truthy check `any(g['is_effective'] for g in guards)` with three-state logic. effective_guards = [g for g in guards if g.get('is_effective') is True]. unknown_guards = [g for g in guards if g.get('is_effective') is None]. broken_guards = [g for g in guards if g.get('is_effective') is False]. Scoring: effective_guards→0.9, unknown_guards→0.6 ('potential custom guard, effectiveness unknown'), broken_guards→0.2, none→0.1. See IMPLEMENTATION-PLAN.md:845-872.
G-01.note: NẾUN spec ở đây mâu thuẫn với source_ref → source_ref thắng. E4: use `is True` / `is None` / `is False` — NEVER `not value` or `bool(value)`.

G-02.change: In _assess_reasoning_quality(): remove keyword bonus for 'however'/'but'. New scoring: base 0.0; +0.3 if len(reasoning)>200; +0.2 if len(reasoning)>500; +0.2 if file:line pattern found in reasoning; +0.15 if sink_file basename appears in reasoning (when file:line match exists); +up to 0.15 for refutation patterns (see IMPLEMENTATION-PLAN.md:900-904). Cap at 1.0.
G-02.note: NẾUN spec ở đây mâu thuẫn với source_ref → source_ref thắng. See IMPLEMENTATION-PLAN.md:874-908 for full new implementation.

downstream_required: After G-01: verify benchmark still passes — three-state guard scoring may affect existing finding scores. Run python3 benchmark/compare.py --all and confirm QS=1.0 FP=0.
After G-02: same benchmark check — reasoning quality change must not regress.
